description: This PHP source file defines the 'Forgotten' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It handles user password reset workflows, including displaying forgot password forms, confirming email submissions, resetting via token validation, and updating passwords. It extends the core Controller class and interacts with models for user data, manages session and response handling, and loads language strings for localization.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class managing the password forgotten process, including display, verification, and password reset

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password form, redirects logged-in users or if email engine is disabled

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles email submission for password reset, validates user email, generates token, and redirects

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Validates reset token and email, prepares the reset password form, sets reset token in session

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes the new password submission, performs validation, updates the user password, and clears tokens
